import java.util.Scanner;

public class C_4 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long a = scanner.nextLong();
        long b = scanner.nextLong();
        long diff = Math.abs(a - b);
        long sqrtDiff = (long) Math.sqrt(diff);
        java.util.ArrayList<Long> divisors = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (long i = 1; i <= sqrtDiff; i++) {
            if (diff % i == 0) {
                divisors.add(i);
                if (i != diff / i) {
                    divisors.add(diff / i);
                }
            }
        }
        long minLcm = lcm(a, b);
        long answer = 0;
        for (Long divisor : divisors) {
            long p = divisor - Math.min(a, b) % divisor;
            long currentLcm = lcm(a + p, b + p);
            if (currentLcm < minLcm) {
                minLcm = currentLcm;
                answer = p;
            } else if (currentLcm == minLcm && p < answer) {
                answer = p;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static long gcd(long p, long q) {
        while (q != 0) {
            long temp = q;
            q = p % q;
            p = temp;
        }
        return p;
    }

    static long lcm(long p, long q) {
        return p / gcd(p, q) * q;
    }
}
